title: convolvulus tricolor subsp. meonanthus
intro: Convolvulus tricolor subsp. meonanthus, commonly known as the 'Tricolour Meadow Bindweed', is a plant species within the Convolvulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Convolvulus tricolor subsp. meonanthus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
